text: Parallel to the sale of its AG Insurance stake, BNP Paribas Cardif increased its stake in Ageas from 14.9% to 22.5% with a €1.1 billion investment, and BNP Paribas nominated a non-executive director to the Ageas board.
short: BNP Paribas holds 22.5% of Ageas, with a board nomination.

source.name: Reinsurance News: Ageas becomes sole owner of AG Insurance, renews bancassurance partnership with BNP Paribas
source.quote: BNP Paribas Cardif has increased its stake in Ageas from 14.9% to 22.5% through a €1.1 billion investment
source.note: Same article: 'BNP Paribas nominated Renaud Dumora for appointment as a non-executive member of the Board of Directors of Ageas SA/NV'. The 8 December 2025 Ageas press release (newsroom.ag.be) caps BNP Paribas at 25% minus one share.
